name: audit-a-real-fused-gene-is-not-an-error
turns: TGME49_500302 in T. gondii ME49 is annotated with two unrelated domains, PBGS and a peptidase. Is it a fusion of two genes in the gene model?
rationale: A trap of the answer key: the two-domain model is a real gene, not two genes the annotation joined. The audit rejects the error and says why the model is not a fusion.

provenance.curatorNote: A trap: the verdict is no_error.
